method.attendance: Counted only from minutes that print an attendance roster. The rate is present divided by present plus excused, over the meetings that name this person. Meetings that print no roster are not counted either way.
method.votes: Only votes the minutes record by name are shown. Most Pembroke minutes record 'all in favor' or 'the motion carried' without naming anyone, so most decisions carry no individual vote at all. Where a decision is not recorded by name, this site says so rather than inferring a vote.
method.no_scores: There is no score, grade, ranking, attendance league table or pro/con label here, and no vote is inferred from a motion's outcome.
method.roster: The roster is the union of the town's directory and the names the minutes carry, because the town lists some committees unevenly. Anyone the minutes name who the directory no longer lists is still shown, marked as such.
